articles.title: Klarna medger fel efter granskning: ”Vi gjorde inte rätt”
articles.summary: ”Jag fick tunnelseende”
articles.body_text: Camilla lurades att godkänna Klarna-köp – får ingen hjälp Bedrägerioffer har nekats hjälp av Klarna när bedragare använt deras uppgifter för att handla. Efter TV4 Nyheternas granskning medger Klarna att företaget gjort fel i två fall. Camilla Andersson, som lurades att själv godkänna köpen med bank-id, har däremot inte fått någon hjälp. – Av Klarna har jag inte fått någon hjälp alls, säger hon. Camilla Andersson trodde att hon pratade med Swedbanks säkerhetsavdelning. Hon fick veta att bedragare tagit lån i hennes namn, och för att stoppa dem uppmanades hon att legitimera sig med bank-id. – De var så otroligt proffsiga. Jag följde bara med. Jag var ju i sån stress. Jag fick tunnelseende, helt enkelt. Man kan tycka att det var otroligt att jag gick på det här, men jag skrämdes upp så enormt av det hela, säger hon. Bedragarna använde hennes uppgifter för att göra köp via Klarna. När Camilla slog larm och bad Klarna stoppa betalningarna fick hon ingen hjälp. – Jag fick beskedet att jag hade använt och signerat med mitt bank-id. Så då får jag ingen mer hjälp, för att jag har varit oaktsam och använt mitt bank-id och signerat med det, säger hon. Olika regler beroende på hur bedrägeriet går till Det finns en viktig skillnad i regelverket. Om en bedragare själv tar sig in på ett konto och gör köp utan kundens godkännande gäller reglerna för obehöriga transaktioner. Om kunden i stället luras att själv godkänna betalningen med bank-id är den juridiska situationen en annan och kallas behörig, och då finns inte samma rätt till automatisk ersättning. Rich Bromley, bedrägerichef på Klarna, bekräftar skillnaden. – Tyvärr finns inte samma regler för ersättning för dem som utsätts för vad vi kallar bedrägerier med godkända betalningar, säger han. TV4 Nyheterna har tidigare berättat om Ingrid, som trodde att hon skulle få hjälp att stoppa ett bedrägeri efter ett köp på ett Klarnakort. I stället blev hon lurad på totalt omkring 90 000 kronor . articles.title: Elgiganten tar bort rakapparat med dold kamera
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Elgiganten tar bort rakapparat med dold kamera
articles.body_text: Annonsen har plockats bort från Elgigantens marknadsplats. Arkivbild. Elgiganten tar bort rakapparat med dold kamera En rakapparat som även fungerar som en dold kamera fanns till försäljning via Elgigantens webbplats, rapporterar Aftonbladet . Nu har produkten plockats bort. Enligt tidningen marknadsfördes produkten, som inte såldes av hemelektronikkedjan utan via en extern återförsäljare på Elgigantens marknadsplats, bland annat med en bild på en kvinna i en säng. Det förekom också beskrivningar om att kameran var svårupptäckt för andra. På onsdagseftermiddagen finns rakapparaten inte längre kvar på webbplatsen. Vi har noggranna rutiner för vilka produkter som får säljas, men just här har vi brustit i vår granskning, säger Josefine Månsson, kommunikationsansvarig på Elgiganten, till tidningen.

articles.title: Trump väcker handelsstriden till liv – så drabbas EU
articles.summary: Dousa (M): Står redo att agera
articles.body_text: Trump väcker handelsstriden till liv – så drabbas EU av nya tullar USA föreslår nya tullar mot bland andra Kina och EU för att stävja ”strukturell överskottskapacitetÏ. Det väcker frågan om en ny global handelsoro. Utrikeshandelsminister Benjamin Dousa (M) varnar för att EU är berett att agera. – Vi står redo för att skydda våra intressen. USA:s president Donald Trump har återigen skärpt tonen i handelspolitiken. På onsdagen föreslog hans administration nya tullar mot 14 handelspartner, däribland EU. USA vill med tullarna motverka ”strukturell överskottskapacitet” i industrin. Det betyder kortfattat att USA anser att vissa länder tillverkar så mycket att de översvämmar världsmarkanden med billiga varor och att det behövs tullar för att sätta stopp för ”överkapaciteten”. Det nya tullförslaget kommer bara veckor efter att Trumps republikaner förlorade mark i mellanårsvalet, något som inte verkar avskräcka presidenten från sin protektionistiska linje. För EU är beskedet ett nytt orosmoln. Unionen har ett avtal med USA som sätter ett tak på 15 procent för tullar, och enligt den amerikanska tjänstemannen ska de nya tullarna respektera det. De ska inte heller läggas ovanpå tidigare tullrundor. Utrikeshandelsminister Benjamin Dousa (M) är ändå skarp i sin kritik: – Trump fortsätter att bedriva sin oseriösa handelspolitik med tullar som främsta vapen. EU och USA har redan en överenskommelse som vi förväntar oss att Trump håller sig till. Det har Europa gjort. Väljer USA ändå att bryta det avtalet, så står vi redo att snabbt kunna agera för att skydda våra intressen, skriver han i en kommentar till TV4 Nyheterna. En högt uppsatt amerikansk tjänsteman säger enligt Reuters att USA söker stabilitet med Kina och beskrev Trumps möte med Xi Jinping förra veckan som "riktigt fantastiskt". Trots det föreslås den högsta tullsatsen, 20 procent, mot Kina. Washington anklagar Peking för att översvämma världsmarknaden med billig export av allt från stål till elfordon och solcellsprodukter. Kina avfärdar USA:s skäl till tullhöjningen. – Den så kallade ”överkapaciteten” är en falsk fråga, och Kina motsätter sig att använda den som en ursäkt för politisk manipulation, säger utrikesministeriets talesperson Guo Jiakun skriver Reuters. Det nya tullbeskedet fick oro att sprida sig bland världens investerare. Ett index som följer aktier över hela världen föll med 0,5 procent.

articles.title: AI-aktier pressas hårt nedåt
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: AI-aktier pressas hårt nedåt
articles.body_text: AI-kopplade aktier, däribland Nvidia och Anthropic, pressas kraftigt nedåt i den inledande onsdagshandeln. Tekniktunga Nasdaqs kompositindex var ned 3,5 procent, S&P 500 pekade på minus 2,5 procent och Dow Jones industriindex handlades ned 1,7 procent strax efter öppning i New York. Chipjätten Nvidia var ned 8,6 procent, medan konkurrenterna AMD och Broadcom pekade på minus 9,4 respektive minus 6,7 procent. AI-bolaget Anthropic fortsätter resan nedåt, aktien som i förra veckan börsintroducerades för 83 dollar per aktie, kostade 76,17 dollar i den tidiga onsdagshandeln, ned 7 procent jämfört med tisdagens slutkurs.

articles.title: Inflationslyft i USA
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Inflationslyft i USA
articles.body_text: Nya siffror visar att kärninflationen stiger i USA. Arkivbild. Kärninflationen i USA steg till 3,3 procent i oktober, enligt det så kallade PCE-måttet. Det var högre än väntat. Oktobersiffran kan jämföras med 3,1 procent föregående månad och en snittprognos bland analytiker på 3,2 procent, enligt nyhetsbyrån Bloomberg. I kärninflationen har energi- och livsmedelspriser rensats bort. Räknar man in alla typer av konsumentpriser var prisuppgången i årstakt 3,8 procent enligt PCE-måttet. Detta var precis vad marknaden hade förutspått. PCE-inflationen ses av USA:s centralbank Federal Reserve (Fed) som den kanske viktigaste indikatorn för inflationstrycket i ekonomin när beslut om framtida styrräntor ska fattas. Till skillnad från KPI-måttet på inflationen, som baseras på en varukorg, beräknas PCE-inflationen på vad som faktiskt konsumeras. Feds inflationsmål ligger på 2,0 procent.

articles.title: Ingrid lurades på 90 000 kronor – Klarna backar
articles.summary: Ingrid lurades på omkring 90 000 kronor efter ett falskt sms. Nu varnar hon inför Black Friday och julhandeln.
articles.body_text: Ingrid blev lurad på jättesumma – med listig Klarna-plan: ”Skamligt” Uppmaningen: Se upp för detta • ”Hur dum får man vara?” 10 november 2026 ・ Uppdaterad: 10 november 2026 Ingrid trodde att hon skulle få hjälp att stoppa ett bedrägeri. I stället blev hon lurad på totalt omkring 90 000 kronor. – Hur dum får man vara? Och det tror jag att de som drabbats av liknande saker också tänker. Det är skamligt, säger hon. Det började med ett sms från ett inkassoföretag om en obetald faktura som Ingrid inte kände igen. Företagsnamnet var äkta, men telefonnumret falskt. När hon ringde upp varnades hon för att ett bedrägeri hade begåtts i hennes namn och kopplades vidare till en påstådd säkerhetsavdelning. – Ett otroligt proffsigt intryck. Det fanns inget som gjorde misstänksamt på att man inte visste vad man höll på med, säger Ingrid, som inte vill använda sitt efternamn av rädsla för fler bedrägerier. I stressen uppgav hon bankuppgifter och bekräftade sin identitet med BankID. Efteråt insåg hon vad som hänt och kontaktade polisen. – Det blir väldigt nära. Nästan lite intimt att bli lurad. Man blir väldigt kränkt, säger Ingrid. Banken kontaktades och uppgifterna spärrades, men Ingrids buffertkonto med drygt 50 000 kronor hade redan länsats. Nästa morgon upptäckte Ingrid även köp för över 40 000 kronor på ett Klarnakort som hon inte hade. – Nästa morgon när jag vaknar och tittar på telefonen så ser jag att det är gjort köp på ett Klarnakort – som jag ju inte har. Och det är gjort köp på drygt 40 000 kronor, säger Ingrid. Hon kontaktade Klarna och spärrade kontot. Bara dagar senare fick hon mejlsvar om att företaget inte hittat några bevis för bedrägeri. Hanteringen upprepades medan tiden gick, berättar hon. – Sen får jag påminnelse om att förfallodatum närmar sig och sen att det har passerat. Då tar jag kontakt med dem igen och frågar vad gör ni. Får svar att jag får betala, säger Ingrid.

articles.title: Publicistiska grunden för journalistik på TV4
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Hur fungerar den publicistiska grunden för nyhets- och samhällsjournalistik på TV4?
articles.body_text: Hur fungerar den publicistiska grunden för nyhets- och samhällsjournalistik på TV4? 9 januari 2024 ・ Uppdaterad: 15 augusti 2025 TV4:s nyhets- och samhällsbevakning ska vara i ögonhöjd med tittarna. Vi vill vara nära, personliga och inkluderande. För alla i hela Sverige. Vi ska vara trovärdiga och relevanta. Vi testar nya visuella former och utvecklar det rörliga berättandet. Vi är både snabba, och fördjupande. Vi ger plats för både humor och allvar. Vi påverkar och berör. Vi avslöjar maktmissbruk, och värnar pressfrihet och yttrandefrihet. Vi producerar Nyhetsmorgon, Nyhetsdagen, Efter fem och kvällsnyheter. Vi nyhetsrapporterar på tv4.se och fördjupar i kortdokumentärerna Nyheterna Story. Vår mångfaldigt prisbelönta redaktion Kalla Fakta granskar makt och missförhållanden. TV4:s nyhets- och samhällsbevakning sker ur ett riksperspektiv, med hela Sverige och världen som bevakningsområde. Vi har 17 rikskorrar på sex orter i Sverige. De finns i Luleå, Umeå, Östersund, Skövde, Göteborg och Malmö. Vi bevakar världen via utrikesreportrar, korrar och stringers. Vår journalistik vilar på respekt för alla människors lika värde, oavsett politisk åskådning, religion eller sexuell läggning. Det innebär att vi låter många röster komma till tals, även de som bär åsikter som inte nödvändigtvis delas av medarbetarna på redaktionen eller TV4. Men det kan också innebära att vi tar bort artikelkommentarer som kränker, eller till exempel avstår gäster i direktsändning där vi bedömer att risken är stor för missbruk av öppenheten. TV4:s nyhets- och samhällsjournalistik är oberoende och obunden. Den står fri från politiska partier, organisationer, och näringsliv. Vi har ingen ledarsida eller politisk färg. Innehållet på våra plattformar bedöms och värderas av redaktörer, producenter och av ansvarig utgivare före publicering. Vi följer grundlagen och skyddar våra källor när de önskar anonymitet. Om vi refererar uppgifter från andra medier redovisar vi vilka medier eller andra informationskällor det handlar om. Annars berättar vi hur vi själva tagit reda på informationen, dock alltid med största respekt för källskydd.

articles.title: Bortglömda fiskar
articles.summary: Teatrar och konserthus lockar allt oftare med olika sidoevenemang. Teater Västernorrland har musikquiz, Folkoperan sänder poddar från sin foajé och på Göteborgsoperan kan man höra föredrag eller vara med och dansa. De uppsluppna tillställningarna, före och efter konserter och föreställningar, lockar också en ny sorts publik. En av Östersjöfestivalens mest omtalade programpunkter, förutom musiken i Berwaldhallen, har varit “Bortglömda fiskar” - en oväntad kulinarisk träff med Kålrotsakademin och provsmakning av “svensk sushi”. “Gensvaret från publiken är enormt. Man vill bli överraskad”, konstaterar Emma Nyberg, exekutiv producent på Berwaldhallen. Och på frågan om vad nors och näbbgädda har att göra i ett konserthus kommer det självklara svaret snabbt: “Att äta gott och att lyssna på klassisk musik hör ihop, båda skärper och öppnar våra sinnen.”

articles.title: Hovkapellet - 500 år av musik
articles.summary: Hovkapellet spelar musik från de 500 år orkestern funnits. Det blir stycken av publikfavoriter som Mozart och Strauss men också exempel från orkesterns allra tidigaste repertoar, såsom den ceremoniella Tornmusiken samt en originalkomposition av Albrici, drottning Kristinas hovmusiker. Allt startade 1526 när Gustav Vasa som nytillträdd kung ville markera sin 'ärorika upphöjning' genom att anställa 12 'pijpare och trompetare'. Idag behövs det cirka 100 musiker för att framföra de operor, baletter och konserter som Hovkapellet spelar på kungliga operan i Stockholm. Vid denna specialinspelade tv-konsert till orkesterns 500-års jubileum i år står Alan Gilbert på pulten. Den tidigare chefsdirigenten för New York Philharmonics och Hamburgs Elbphilharmonie, är numera Hovkapellets musikchef och jubileumskvällens ciceron.

articles.title: Canadian astronaut welcomes baby girl from space station
articles.summary: Joshua Kutryk, currently on his first space mission, is just the fourth astronaut in history to miss the birth of a child while aboard the International Space Station.
articles.body_text: A Canadian astronaut aboard the International Space Station is celebrating the birth of his third child from hundreds of miles above Earth. Joshua Kutryk and his wife, Heather Kutryk, welcomed their daughter as the astronaut takes part in a six-month space mission that began in October, the Canadian Space Agency announced on Tuesday. "Even with the distance between us, we feel incredibly connected as we welcome our new little star into our lives," said the couple in a statement shared by the agency. Joshua Kutryk, currently on his first space mission, is just the fourth astronaut in history to miss the birth of a child while aboard the International Space Station. The couple have two older children, aged five and seven. "We are very proud of our growing family and are looking forward to getting our little crew of five all reunited." In a statement, the couple said that Joshua's spaceflight was a "childhood dream" come true. "We hope to show our children that big dreams are worth pursuing, that hard work and determination matter, and that with the support of family and a strong community, extraordinary things are possible," they said. Prior to becoming an astronaut, Kutryk, from Fort Saskatchewan, Alberta, was a fighter pilot and a colonel in the Royal Canadian Air Force. He was recruited by the Canadian Space Agency in 2017. Kutryk was the only Canadian selected to be part of NASA's SpaceX Crew-13 mission, where four astronauts are conducting scientific experiments and testing new technologies in space. The crew also includes two US astronauts, Luke Delaney and Jessica Watkins, and one Russian astronaut, Sergey Teteryatnikov. Before their take off on 1 October, Heather Kutryk told Canada's public broadcaster CBC News that her family had been preparing for years before the mission, saying it was "a long time coming".

articles.title: US stocks fall further as fears over AI intensify
articles.summary: All three main US indexes were down in early trading, with the tech-dominated Nasdaq down almost 4%.
articles.body_text: Big technology firms connected to AI continued to see share prices fall on Wednesday, with stock in Nvidia and Anthropic dropping sharply in early trading. The surge in Nvidia shares after boss Jensen Huang was reinstated was temporary, and the general stock sell-off continued, with all three main US stock market indices down. The tech-dominated Nasdaq has shed over 2%. The declines come amid concerns over the level and sustainability of AI investment which has rattled investors in recent weeks. Shares in other major tech firms, including Amazon, Tesla and SpaceX, Micrsoft and Meta were also down. Nvidia's share price was down 8% in early trading on Wednesday, extending Tuesday's slide as the boost from Huang's return eased. The resignation and subsequent reinstatement of Nvidia boss Jensen Huang after revelations of his extra marital affairs has seen the market value of the world's premier AI chipmaker fluctuate wildly. Given Nvidia's position as both supplier and financier of many other firms involved in the AI rollout, its rocky fortnight has had a wider impact. The US government also announced a raft of new tariffs on countries and trading partners on Wednesday as part of President Donald Trump's flagship trade policy. The value of big tech companies have sheltered the US economy from global economic shocks, including tariffs, but share prices in recent weeks have been volatile in response to the US midterm elections and other events in the AI industry. Investors have taken fright at Democrat gains in the US midterm elections, with many having campaigned for tougher regulation of AI firms and even a moratorium on the development of new data centres. Questions also remain about whether the huge sums being invested in AI will eventually pay off. "It seems that these companies are trying to one-up each other on the amount of money that they're spending but you have to show that it's worth it, and that's where Wall Street is saying I don't know," said Todd Schoenberger, chief investment officer at CrossCheck Management.

articles.title: Five Russian military jets hit in airfield strike, says Ukraine
articles.summary: The Savasleyka airfield hosts aircraft used by Russia to launch hypersonic missiles and glide bombs at Ukraine.
articles.body_text: Ukraine has said it damaged five Russian military aircraft in an attack on Russia's Savasleyka airfield, 300km (185 miles) east of Moscow. Three MiG-31 and two Su-34s aircraft were hit, Kyiv's General Staff said, adding that the extent of the damage was still being assessed but that "there may be even better news to come". It did not elaborate on what weapons it had used to hit the airfield. Russia has not commented on the strikes. The airfield at Savasleyka, in Russia's Nizhny Novgorod region, has been a target for Ukraine for several years. It hosts aircraft used by Russia to launch hypersonic missiles and glide bombs. The take-off of MiG-31s in particular frequently triggers nationwide alerts across Ukraine, as the Kinzhal missiles they carry have been known to hit large infrastructure and military targets and are difficult to shoot down. Overnight, Kyiv also said it hit two oil refineries in Russia's Samara region some 800km (500 miles) from the front line – the latest in a series of long-range strikes which have dented Moscow's oil processing capacity. "Did you repair them? We'll hit them again," the defence ministry in Kyiv said. Samara region governor Vyacheslav Fedorishchev said the night-time attacks had been "a true ordeal", with more than 145 drones shot down. One person was killed and several towns experienced power outages, Fedorishchev said. Kyiv also said it had hit a radar system as well as fuel and logistics depots across Ukrainian territories currently occupied by Russia. "Without fuel, military vehicles cannot move; without ammunition, artillery falls silent," the defence ministry said, adding that every successful hit meant Moscow could carry out fewer strikes. Kyiv has developed a thriving weapons industry and Ukrainian strikes on Russian targets well beyond the front line have become commonplace in the years since Moscow launched its full-scale invasion. On Tuesday, President Vladimir Putin called for a tightening of security measures across the country's energy facilities.

articles.title: Israeli strike kills senior Hamas security official and family in Gaza City
articles.summary: Mohammed Abu al-Ouf, head of Hamas's internal security service in northern Gaza, was killed with his wife and two teenage daughters, doctors say.
articles.body_text: An Israeli air strike in the Gaza Strip has killed a senior Hamas security official and three members of his family, according to local doctors and the Hamas-run interior ministry. Mohammed Abu al-Ouf, 47, the head of Hamas's internal security service in northern Gaza, his wife and their two teenage daughters died when their apartment in Shati refugee camp in Gaza City was bombed at dawn, the ministry said. The Israeli military said Abu al-Ouf was a "terrorist" and that he was eliminated "to remove the threat he posed". On Tuesday, the overall commander of Hamas's internal security service was among 10 Palestinians reportedly killed in Israeli strikes. Wednesday's strike in Shati caused extensive damage to the Abu al-Ouf family's apartment. Photos showed the exterior wall and several interior walls were destroyed, with rubble and broken furniture left scattered across the floor. An interior ministry statement said that Abu al-Ouf was killed along with his wife Noura, 41, and their daughters Yusra, 15, and Jana, 13. It condemned the attack as a "heinous crime" and accused Israel of targeting security personnel in Gaza "in an effort to spread chaos within Palestinian society". Hamas's internal security service is responsible for enforcing discipline, protecting the group's infrastructure and rooting out informants. Israel's military said in a statement that Abu al-Ouf was a "significant figure" who had served as "a key source of expertise" in efforts to restrict Israeli counter-terrorism operations in Gaza. "His elimination is a blow to the apparatus's leadership capabilities and follows yesterday's elimination of his commander," it added. On Tuesday, an Israeli drone strike in western Gaza City killed Naeem Abu Nahel, the head of Hamas's internal security service.

articles.title: Protesters call on Israel to free Palestinian student held without charge
articles.summary: Mahdi Tunsi, 26, was taken from his university dormitory earlier this month and has since been held without charge.
articles.body_text: Israeli students, activists and academics are calling for the release of a Palestinian undergraduate who was taken from his university dormitory by Israeli police earlier this month and has since been held without charge. Mahdi Tunsi, a 26-year-old sociology and criminology student at the Hebrew University of Jerusalem, appeared in an Israeli court in the city on Tuesday - a hearing that was held behind closed doors. Israeli police say he was arrested "concerning ties to an act of terrorism". Authorities have requested what is known as "administrative detention", which allows the Israeli state to detain people indefinitely without charge on the basis of secret evidence that they cannot see. "We definitely think this is a political arrest," said Dr Yael Berda, one of Tunsi's university professors. Tunsi, a Palestinian resident of occupied East Jerusalem who works with well-known Jewish-Palestinian campaign groups, was arrested a month after Israel held an election that saw Arab-led parties win a record 19 seats in parliament, the Knesset, and Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's right-wing coalition lose its majority. Since then, Berda said she had seen an intensifying campaign against Palestinian rights. Outside the Jerusalem District Court on Tuesday, demonstrators waved placards with a black-and-white image of Tunsi, while crying out "shame" in unison. "There's no due process - [administrative detention is] a sugar-coated term for being kidnapped and held as a hostage," said Dr Ofer Cassif, a Member of the Knesset representing the Arab-led Joint List alliance. "We must all stand firm against such crimes. It's unacceptable." Since the Hamas-led attack on Israel on 7 October 2023, which triggered the Gaza war, the number of people in administrative detention has more than doubled . In October, there were more than 3,100 in administrative detention, according to Israel Prison Service figures published by Israeli rights group HaMoked. Most of them are Palestinians from the occupied West Bank.

articles.title: Colombian police storm supermarket to free 76 held hostage for 17 hours
articles.summary: One gunman was killed after what the country's president described as a robbery of a cash-laden armoured car gone wrong.
articles.body_text: Colombian security forces have freed around 76 shoppers and employees who had been held hostage for about 17 hours at a supermarket in the city of Cartagena. Gunmen had stormed into the building at 08:00 local time (13:00 GMT) on Tuesday after what Colombian President Abelardo de la Espriella described as a failed attempt at robbing an armoured car carrying money. They held those inside at gunpoint while trying to negotiate their getaway. With the situation becoming ever more intense as the day progressed, de la Espriella gave the green light for special forces and police to launch a daring operation to free the hostages, killing one gunman. Residents living near the supermarket reported hearing explosions as the security forces moved into the building. Police later confirmed that officers had used stun grenades to overpower the hostage-takers. Four have been arrested. De la Espriella described it as "an extraordinary joint operation", which he said had been carried out "flawlessly". He flew into the northern city to oversee the operation personally. He could be seen flanked by the commanders of the operation with a handgun strapped to his belt, in footage released following its conclusion. De la Espriella said the gunmen had been given the chance to hand themselves in but had refused. Earlier in the day, the assailants had freed 10 of the hostages, among them elderly women. But they continued to hold around 20, even as a police helicopter hovered above and special forces teams prepared to enter the building, located in a popular shopping centre. Local media report that, as well as asking for safe passage out of the supermarket, the gunmen also demanded nearly $2m (£1.5m) and armoured vehicles.

articles.title: Hera mission images from asteroid crash show stadium-sized crater
articles.summary: The asteroid's surface was transformed after a spacecraft was deliberately crashed into it four years ago
articles.body_text: The first images of an asteroid that Nasa deliberately crashed into have revealed a stadium-sized crater on its surface. The extensive damage was caused when a Nasa spacecraft hit the asteroid Dimorphos in 2022. The asteroid posed no threat, but this was a test of our planetary defences to see if it was possible to knock a space rock off course. Four years on, a European Space Agency (ESA) spacecraft called Hera is scouring the scene to fully assess the aftermath of the collision. "The crater is almost as large as the body itself, which is really, really spectacular," said Dr Sabina Raducan, a planetary scientist, who is on the Hera science team. "It's hard to describe in words all the excitement to actually finally see what happened. And as a crater person, I can also say it's beautiful." The original 2022 crash test was carried out by a Nasa spacecraft called Dart which hurtled into Dimorphos at 14,000mph (22,000km/h). It was such a big smash-up that the trail of debris, measuring about 6,200 miles long (10,000km), was spotted by telescopes on Earth and in space. Dimorphos is about 150m (500ft) wide and was partly chosen as the target because it is one of an asteroid pair - it orbits around a larger space rock called Didymos, which is about 730m (2,400ft) wide. The crash showed it was possible to change the path of the smaller asteroid. Before the collision, it took Dimorphos 11 hours and 55 minutes to orbit around Didymos. After the crash, the duration of its orbit had shrunk by about 33 minutes. A key objective of the Hera mission is to measure the mass of Dimorphos, in order to work out how effective the spacecraft's shove was. This information would be vital if we ever spotted a space rock that was on a collision course with Earth.

articles.title: Russia's own figures show it has lost nearly 500,000 people in Ukraine war
articles.summary: Leaked data reveal how the full-scale invasion of Ukraine has fundamentally changed mortality patterns in Russia.
articles.body_text: At least 490,334 Russian soldiers have died since the start of the war in Ukraine in 2022, according to Russian government statistics analysed by the BBC. The leaked Rosstat data reveal how the full-scale invasion of Ukraine has fundamentally changed mortality patterns in Russia, and show the high cost paid in human life in a war that Vladimir Putin had assumed would last only days but is now almost five years old. BBC Russian has had access to more than 11 million death records from 2021 to September 2026, after a hack by Belarusian group Cyber Partisans BY and Ukraine's Silent Crow. Russia's statistics agency admitted to a cyber-attack, but denied any protected information had been leaked. Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said on Wednesday that only Russia's defence ministry could officially report data on losses: "I suggest no other data be taken into account." The defence ministry has not released any official casualty figures for several years. Together with independent Russian outlet Mediazona, BBC Russian has compared the Rosstat data with its own list of confirmed military deaths, pulled from open sources since the start of the invasion, and it has found matches for 90% of the records. Military experts estimate that the BBC's list of 290,012 deaths, gleaned from official reports, social media, new memorials and graves, may account for 45-55% of the true death toll, which would range from 527,295 to 644,471. The records show that 65% of 18 to 24 year-olds in Russia who lost their lives in 2025 died in the war. For those aged 25-34 the number was 59%. Only among 45 to 54 year-olds does cardiovascular disease claim more Russian lives than the conflict. The data also reveal the extent of losses in specific areas of Ukraine. Some 20,000 Russian soldiers died fighting for control of 10 Ukrainian villages whose combined pre-war population was 12,000. During the fight for one small village called Andriivka, south of the town of Bakhmut in Donetsk region, 1,122 Russians lost their lives. Before the war 74 people lived there. Russia does not give public figures for losses sustained since the war began in February 2022. And two years ago Rosstat stopped publishing data of deaths from external causes, which was used to gauge the extent of military losses. For example, only 70% of deaths we have established of soldiers from the occupied regions of Donetsk and Luhansk in eastern Ukraine who fought in the Russian army were accounted for in the Rosstat files.

articles.title: My family were killed in Ukraine. My mum blamed Zelensky's troops - the truth is complicated
articles.summary: BBC journalist Anastasiya Gribanova investigates who killed her father and grandparents in the war.
articles.body_text: I am sitting on my balcony in Kyiv looking at a photo of a garden in the village I grew up in, in eastern Ukraine. The plot is overgrown with thick grass, and two wooden stakes are planted in the ground. Despite the warm sunshine, I find myself shivering. The woman who sent me the photo says the stakes mark the graves of my grandparents, killed as the Ukrainian-Russian front line reached our little community. Not far away, in another garden in the village, the body of my father, Serezha, is buried in a greenhouse. I cover the Russia-Ukraine war for the BBC World Service, but found myself in the middle of that story in February last year when my mother sent me a devastating text message. "Granny, grandad and Serezha are gone. Now there is no-one left," it said. Because not only had I lost three beloved family members, my mother blamed Ukraine for their deaths - the country where I was born and have lived for most of my life. Mum was born in Siberia. From the moment Moscow launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022, she had supported Russia in the conflict. Backing Moscow is not that unusual in the Donbas region - the predominantly Russian-speaking part of eastern Ukraine where my village Dachne is located. After pro-Russian forces captured large parts of the Donbas in 2014, many of those who stayed supported Moscow over Kyiv, a stance cemented by exposure to Russian state TV. Now the Russians occupy almost 80% of Donetsk - the part of the Donbas where my village is. Over the past nearly five years, since Russia's full-scale invasion, entire towns and cities have been razed to the ground . I had already fallen out with my sister Sasha, who had been living in Moscow with her young family when the war broke out. She refused to take sides - I felt hurt and cut her off. But earlier this year, around the first anniversary of dad's death, Sasha unexpectedly texted me. We started talking over text about our childhood - the way things used to be. I realised I was not angry with her anymore. She too was grieving, missing dad just as much as I was. I told her I wanted to make a documentary about dad and she was very supportive. I knew then that I had an ally on my journey. But we decided not to tell our mum just yet.

articles.title: US announces new tariffs on host of countries including China
articles.summary: The new levies would hit many of America's biggest trading partners, including China and the EU.
articles.body_text: The US has announced a fresh raft of tariffs as President Donald Trump pushes ahead with his signature trade policy. The new taxes charged on imports to America are set to hit many of the country's biggest trading partners - China, the European Union and 12 other jurisdictions. The move follows the White House's investigation into the trade practices of other countries in March after the US Supreme Court ruled Trump's previously announced Liberation Day tariffs were illegal . China is facing the highest rate of up to 40%, followed by Vietnam at up to 35% and then others facing either 20% or 25%. The new duties are not expected to take effect until next year. Tariffs are taxes levied on imported goods. The amount is typically calculated as a percentage of the good's value and paid to the government by businesses importing the products from abroad. Some of these rates will be effectively reduced because of caps on tariffs Trump has agreed to. Individual countries also face different levies. The proposed tariffs will affect China, the European Union, Singapore, Switzerland, Indonesia, Malaysia, Cambodia, Thailand, Korea, Vietnam, Taiwan, Bangladesh, Japan, and India. US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said the latest tariffs issued would "level the playing field for American workers and chart a new, more sustainable course for the world economy". He claimed that many of America's trading partners had "for decades" adopted industrial strategies which included "targeting manufacturing, wage and labor suppression" as well as "other market distorting practices that tilt the trade balance in their favor while eroding America's manufacturing base". But economists have warned tariffs can fuel inflation and push prices up for consumers if businesses pass on higher costs, as well as dampen global trade. Trump has repeatedly threatened or imposed tariffs during his second term, arguing they will boost US manufacturing and create jobs.

articles.summary: The verdict follows a months-long trial in New York.
articles.body_text: Huawei has been found guilty of conspiracy to steal trade secrets and bank fraud, but not guilty of the more serious overarching racketeering charge in a landmark case in the US. In a two-month trial, prosecutors accused the Chinese technology and telecommunications giant of lying, cheating and stealing to gain any competitive advantage. Huawei's defence team argued that prosecutors had decided Huawei was a criminal organisation and built its case from there, but the firm's success was due to its own innovation. Huawei said the racketeering acquittal "confirms that these allegations lack factual basis", adding that it would "take all necessary legal actions to defend our rights and interests". Jurors in a Brooklyn court found Huawei guilty of 10 out of 12 counts, which included conspiracy to violate US sanctions. However, the jury declined to convict Huawei of the racketeering conspiracy charge, which required members to find the firm acted like a criminal enterprise. Federal prosecutors first announced the charges against Huawei in 2019, after the dramatic arrest in late 2018 of senior executive Meng Wanzhou in Canada. Meng, also known as Cathy Meng, was held for three years in Canada before she was released to return to China through a deal with US prosecutors. During closing arguments last week, assistant US attorney Meredith Arfa told jurors Huawei spent 20 years doing whatever it took to expand its business, including lying to banks about its business dealings in Iran and stealing technology secrets from rival firms to ensure it had a competitive edge. "For decades, Huawei and three of its subsidiaries conducted their business in the United States on the basis of lies and theft," US Attorney General Todd Blanche said in statement . "Thanks to the work of the FBI and our federal prosecutors, those who engaged in these criminal activities will be held accountable." articles.body_text: El presidente Donald Trump firmó una declaración de desastre mayor para Florida, una decisión que permite la entrega de asistencia federal a los residentes y comunidades perjudicados por las históricas inundaciones que afectaron al estado. La medida permitirá destinar recursos tanto a los propietarios de viviendas que sufrieron daños no cubiertos por sus seguros como a las autoridades locales que participan en las labores de emergencia y recuperación. Según Fox 35, la declaración incluye a seis condados: Brevard, Indian River, Martin, Okeechobee, Palm Beach y St. Lucie. Los residentes que cumplan los requisitos podrían recibir apoyo para cubrir alojamiento temporal, reparar sus viviendas y afrontar pérdidas materiales que no estén protegidas por una póliza de seguro. Antes de solicitar la asistencia de FEMA, se recomienda fotografiar o grabar los daños y presentar los reclamos correspondientes ante las compañías aseguradoras. El congresista estadounidense Mike Haridopolos señaló que espera que el proceso de solicitud avance rápidamente y que los formularios de FEMA podrían estar disponibles desde el miércoles. “Deberíamos tener los formularios de FEMA en línea. Allí podrán completarlos para saber si califican para la asistencia individual, por lo que habrá ayuda individual para las personas que la necesiten”, afirmó. Mientras los residentes esperan la ayuda federal, organizaciones y vecinos mantienen sus propias iniciativas para atender a quienes sufrieron los efectos de las inundaciones. En Cocoa, la escuela primaria Saturn organizó una jornada de voluntariado para llevar alimentos, agua, productos de limpieza, ropa y otros artículos esenciales a los vecindarios afectados. El director del centro educativo, Javier Alfonso, explicó que la escuela y sus organizaciones colaboradoras entregan estos suministros sin costo e incluso los trasladan directamente a las familias que no pueden salir de sus comunidades inundadas. Algunos residentes tuvieron que acercarse a los voluntarios en kayak o en embarcaciones para recoger los productos. Alfonso aseguró que la institución continuará coordinando estas labores de apoyo mientras las familias sigan necesitando ayuda. articles.title: Final explicado de “La emperatriz divorciada”: así terminó la primera temporada en Disney Plus
articles.summary: El K-drama protagonizado por Shin Min-a y Lee Jong-suk cerró su primera entrega en Disney+ con el icónico juicio de divorcio, la fuga al Reino Occidental y una escena final que adelanta su continuación. Te contamos todo lo que pasó en los episodios 9 y 10.
articles.body_text: El fenómeno coreano “La emperatriz divorciada” (The Remarried Empress) llegó a su esperado desenlace de temporada en Disney Plus con el estreno simultáneo de los episodios 9 y 10. Protagonizada por Shin Min-a, Ju Ji-hoon, Lee Jong-suk y Lee Se-young, la serie cerró su primer arco con una de las escenas más icónicas del webtoon original: el juicio de divorcio en el Imperio del Este y el inicio de una nueva era en el Reino Occidental. Si te quedaron dudas sobre los últimos giros de la trama, el destino de Rashta o qué significa la última escena de Heinrey, repasamos punto por punto cómo terminó la primera temporada de “La emperatriz divorciada”. El episodio 9 se centra de lleno en la ruptura oficial entre el emperador Sovieshu y Navier. Convencido de que Navier no puede darle un heredero debido a un supuesto incidente de su infancia, Sovieshu decide poner fin a su matrimonio para legitimar al hijo que espera con Rashta y asegurar la sucesión imperial. Lejos de derrumbarse frente a la corte, Navier mantiene una postura fría e impecable. En pleno tribunal, acepta el divorcio sin oponer resistencia, pero lanza el contragolpe que deja atónito al emperador: solicita autorización inmediata para volver a casarse con Heinrey, el recién coronado rey del Reino Occidental. Con este movimiento, Navier recupera el control de su destino y deja en evidencia que su valor como gobernante trasciende el trono del Este. Uno de los puntos más celebrados por los seguidores de la serie es el colapso emocional de Sovieshu. Aunque fue él quien impulsó la separación, al ver que Navier está dispuesta a marcharse para siempre y convertirse en reina de una nación rival, intenta frenar los planes. En el episodio 10, desesperado por retenerla, el emperador llega al extremo de encarcelar tanto a Navier como a Heinrey dentro del palacio. Durante su confrontación final, Sovieshu le ruega que no lo abandone, pero Navier le deja en claro que, incluso si logra encerrar su cuerpo, su corazón y su lealtad ya no le pertenecen. Antes del juicio, Navier había viajado al Reino Occidental para asistir a la coronación de Heinrey, momento en el que el monarca le confesó abiertamente sus sentimientos y le pidió matrimonio. Tras quedar atrapados en el Imperio del Este por orden de Sovieshu, ambos unen fuerzas para escapar. Gracias a la astucia de Navier y a las habilidades mágicas de Heinrey (quien posee la capacidad de transformarse en ave), logran burlar la seguridad imperial y cruzar la frontera rumbo al Oeste. La temporada cierra con la llegada triunfal de ambos a su nuevo reino, donde Navier por fin es recibida como una igual y no como una pieza reemplazable de la corte. Con la salida de Navier del palacio, Rashta finalmente consigue su mayor ambición: ser proclamada la nueva emperatriz del Imperio del Este. Sin embargo, lejos de alcanzar el final feliz que imaginaba, su posición queda en un terreno sumamente inestable. Sovieshu luce cada vez más obsesionado con la pérdida de Navier y resentido por el rumbo que tomaron las cosas, mientras que la nobleza del Este comienza a desconfiar de la inexperiencia y los secretos del pasado de Rashta. Su arco queda completamente abierto, anticipando que su caída apenas comienza. Aunque Disney+ todavía no ha emitido un anuncio oficial de renovación, el cierre del episodio 10 deja todo listo para una segunda entrega. No solo quedan pendientes las consecuencias políticas del matrimonio entre Navier y Heinrey, la amenaza de Sovieshu de destruir todo lo que ella ama y el destino de Rashta en el trono, sino que en la escena final Heinrey rompe la cuarta pared mirando a cámara con un “See you soon” (“Nos vemos pronto”). Considerando que la serie rompió récords de audiencia en la plataforma y que los 10 episodios apenas cubrieron la primera etapa del webtoon original, la continuación de la historia parece cuestión de tiempo.

articles.title: Jessica Newton: “No siempre se gana la corona, pero los resultados a largo plazo para Luren van a ser maravillosos”
articles.summary: La representante de Puerto Rico, Jennifer Barreto, se convirtió en la primera mamá en ganar el Miss Universo. Jessica Newton destaca el mensaje de su triunfo y el legado que dejó la representante peruana, quien llegó al Top 30.
articles.body_text: Durante décadas, la maternidad fue una barrera para las mujeres que soñaban con convertirse en Miss Universo. La noche del 24 de noviembre, esa historia tuvo un desenlace distinto. Jennifer Barreto, representante de Puerto Rico y madre de una niña, conquistó la corona y se convirtió en la primera madre en ganar el certamen en sus 75 años de historia. Entre los aplausos también estuvo el Perú, representado por Luren Márquez, quien llegó al Top 30 y, aunque no alcanzó la final, consiguió que los paisajes y tradiciones de su natal Ica trascendieran fronteras. Desde Puerto Rico, Jessica Newton, directora de la Organización Miss Perú, compartió con El Comercio su emoción por el resultado del certamen y destacó el significado de una victoria que rompe con antiguas restricciones. “Yo creo que las mujeres no deben detenerse nunca en perseguir sus sueños. Hoy en día las mujeres pueden tenerlo todo y seguir soñando. No tienen que abandonar sus sueños cuando asumen un papel de madre, de esposa. Debe ser más bien un complemento adicional y eso no solamente se aplica a los certámenes de belleza, se aplica a todos los sueños”, expresó. Newton, quien presenció la coronación de Barreto, recordó especialmente una escena: el esposo y la pequeña hija de la ganadora acompañándola en aquella noche decisiva. Para la directora del Miss Perú, el triunfo de Barreto deja una reflexión que va más allá de los concursos de belleza. “Nunca hay que dejar de soñar ni cerrar la puerta a las ilusiones, nunca hay que pensar que ya pasó el tiempo de cumplirlos”, sostuvo. Mientras Puerto Rico celebraba su sexta corona, Luren Márquez cerraba una etapa que también dejó motivos de satisfacción para el Perú. La representante iqueña consiguió ingresar al Top 30 entre 116 candidatas, aunque no avanzó a la siguiente ronda. Para Jessica Newton, el mayor logro de Luren Márquez fue llevar al mundo la riqueza de su tierra natal a través de “Oasis de Ica”, el traje típico diseñado por Beto Pinedo, inspirado en la Huacachina, las Líneas de Nasca y la vendimia. Con esta propuesta, la reina peruana cumplió su sueño de mostrar sus raíces en el escenario del Miss Universo. Su clasificación al Top 30, entre 116 candidatas, también reafirma, según Newton, la presencia del Perú entre los países competitivos del certamen. “Estar dentro de las clasificadas es un gran logro”, destacó. Y aunque su participación terminó antes de la ronda final, las oportunidades para Luren continúan. Su desempeño despertó el interés de medios internacionales como Telemundo, ¡Hola! y People en Español, además de la prensa de República Dominicana y Ecuador. Tras cumplir una agenda de entrevistas en Puerto Rico, tiene previstas nuevas apariciones en Miami antes de regresar al Perú la próxima semana. “Ella tiene muchas fortalezas, se reinventa, se levanta. Está totalmente enfocada en nuevas metas desde hoy”, señaló Newton, convencida de que esta experiencia impulsará su carrera. “No siempre vamos a ganar la corona, pero la exposición de la persona que compite, del país y los resultados a largo plazo estoy segura de que para Luren van a ser maravillosos”, concluyó.

articles.title: Gobierno busca acelerar la Línea 2 del Metro tras primer pago de deuda a la concesionaria
articles.summary: El MTC negocia una adenda que permitiría poner en operación tres estaciones de Ate en el segundo semestre de 2027 y concluir el tramo hasta el óvalo Bolognesi entre finales de 2028 e inicios de 2029.
articles.body_text: El ministro de Transportes y Comunicaciones, Angello Tangherlini, reveló que el Gobierno realizó un primer pago de la deuda que mantenía con la Sociedad Concesionaria Metro de Lima Línea 2, encargada de la construcción de la Línea 2 del Metro de Lima. Este desembolso permitió iniciar la negociación de una adenda de alineamiento de objetivos para acelerar el proyecto. “Hace unos días hicimos un primer pago de la deuda que tiene el Gobierno con Línea 2 y esto nos ha permitido sentarnos a negociar una adenda que nos permita poner en operación tres estaciones del lado de Ate que ya están culminadas y esperamos que puedan iniciar operaciones sobre el segundo semestre del 2027”, explicó durante su presentación en CADE Ejecutivos 2026. Con esta negociación, también se busca acelerar la conclusión y puesta en operación de las estaciones ubicadas entre la estación Clínica San Juan de Dios y el óvalo Bolognesi, cuyas obras podrían concluir a finales de 2028 o inicios de 2029. “De esta manera, tendríamos ya en operación la etapa 1A y 1B, quedando la etapa 2 para su conclusión hacia el año 2030”, destacó Tangherlini. articles.title: El dólar abre al alza en S/3,49 ante mayor crecimiento e inflación en Estados Unidos
articles.summary: El precio del dólar inició la jornada de este miércoles en S/3,499 en el mercado cambiario peruano, por encima de los S/3,484 del cierre anterior, con un avance de 0,43%.
articles.body_text: El precio del dólar inició la jornada de este miércoles en S/3,499 en el mercado cambiario peruano, por encima de los S/3,484 del cierre anterior, con un avance de 0,43%. La moneda estadounidense se acerca a los S/3,50 en un contexto de mayor crecimiento de la economía de Estados Unidos, persistentes presiones inflacionarias e incertidumbre por las nuevas medidas arancelarias impulsadas por la administración de Donald Trump. “El mayor dinamismo de la economía estadounidense y la persistencia de las presiones inflacionarias refuerzan las expectativas de que la Reserva Federal mantenga una política monetaria restrictiva. A ello se suma la incertidumbre comercial, que favorece la demanda de dólares como activo refugio y genera presión sobre las monedas emergentes”, explicó Jorge Luis Huayta, trader FX de Kambista. En los mercados internacionales, el Índice del Dólar Estadounidense (DXY) avanzó 0,05%, hasta los 103.895 puntos, luego de conocerse que el PBI de Estados Unidos del tercer trimestre fue revisado al alza, hasta una tasa anualizada de 4,3%, frente al 3,4% de la estimación inicial. Asimismo, el índice de precios del gasto en consumo personal (PCE) registró una inflación interanual de 3,8%, mientras su componente subyacente alcanzó el 3,3%. Por su parte, el oro retrocedió 2,22% y la plata cayó 3,83%, mientras el petróleo WTI y el Brent avanzaron 1,14% y 0,89%, respectivamente. En el ámbito local, Perú registró un superávit en cuenta corriente de US$2.944 millones durante el tercer trimestre de 2026, resultado que fortalece la posición externa del país y constituye un respaldo para el sol. Sin embargo, el Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (MEF) redujo su proyección de crecimiento económico para este año de 3,4% a 3,1%, principalmente por el impacto esperado del Fenómeno El Niño Costero extraordinario sobre sectores como la pesca y la agricultura. De cara al cierre de la sesión, el análisis de Kambista señala que la atención estará centrada en las operaciones del Banco Central de Reserva (BCR), ante los vencimientos de depósitos por S/7.700 millones y swaps cambiarios de compra por S/399.9 millones. Las eventuales colocaciones de swaps cambiarios de venta, las expectativas sobre las tasas de interés estadounidenses y los flujos locales de oferta y demanda de divisas serán factores relevantes para determinar si el dólar supera la barrera de los S/3,50 durante la jornada.

articles.title: Trump aprueba la declaración de desastre para Florida por las inundaciones de noviembre
articles.summary: Donald Trump aprobó la declaración de desastre en Florida por las inundaciones de noviembre, habilitando asistencia federal para los afectados.
articles.body_text: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, aprobó una declaración de desastre para Florida, que da acceso a ayudas del Gobierno de EE.UU. a los damnificados por las inundaciones de principios de noviembre en seis condados del estado, según la Agencia Federal para el Manejo de Emergencias (FEMA, en inglés). Los residentes de Brevard, Indian River, St. Lucie, Martin y Palm Beach, en la costa atlántica, y de Okeechobee, en el interior, podrán pedir ayudas para alojamiento y para reparar sus casas, informó -en la red social X- la División de Manejo de Emergencias de Florida. La FEMA costeará además una parte de los gastos de los gobiernos locales para la remoción de escombros y en las medidas de emergencia. El gobernador de Florida, el republicano Ron DeSantis, había pedido la declaración en una carta a Trump fechada el 9 de noviembre, en la que reportaba 2.973 viviendas afectadas según un primer recuento de los condados. El senador republicano por Florida Rick Scott contó -en X- que Trump lo llamó para comunicarle que había concedido la petición. Horas antes, la congresista demócrata por Florida Lois Frankel había reclamado -en una rueda de prensa con autoridades locales- que la ayuda llegara antes del festivo de este jueves. “Cientos de familias de Florida han perdido sus casas, sus autos y sus pertenencias, y afrontan un Día de Acción de Gracias especialmente difícil”, afirmó Frankel -en un comunicado- tras la aprobación. DeSantis anunció el pasado lunes que Florida presentará otra solicitud de declaración de desastre y dijo que algunas zonas del estado habían registrado entre 380 y 510 milímetros de lluvia durante la última semana. Las agencias estatales suman casi quinientos rescates en zonas inundadas, según el gobernador. La primera solicitud respondía a las lluvias del 1 al 3 de noviembre, que alcanzaron hasta 627 milímetros en el condado de Brevard, donde está Cabo Cañaveral, sin un huracán ni una tormenta tropical de por medio, según el Servicio Meteorológico Nacional (NWS, en inglés).

articles.summary: María Corina Machado afirmó que Edmundo González regresará pronto a Venezuela, en medio de las expectativas de la oposición.
articles.body_text: La líder opositora María Corina Machado aseguró este miércoles que el excandidato presidencial Edmundo González Urrutia, quien se encuentra exiliado en España desde 2024, “pronto” estará de vuelta en Venezuela. “Pronto lo tendremos aquí en Venezuela”, aseguró Machado ante los estudiantes de la Universidad Central de Venezuela (UCV), en un mensaje que su formación, Vente Venezuela, consideró el primero a la nación, justo cuando se cumple un mes del regreso de la opositora a su país. Machado recordó que el 28 de julio de 2024, cuando se celebraron elecciones presidenciales en Venezuela, González Urrutia “recibió el mandato” de la oposición para enfrentarse a Nicolás Maduro. Ese año, ella encabezó la campaña política de la mayor coalición opositora, Plataforma Unitaria Democrática (PUD), para apoyar a González Urrutia, dado que estaba inhabilitada y no pudo postularse para las presidenciales de ese año, cuando el Consejo Nacional Electoral (CNE) proclamó como mandatario reelecto al ahora depuesto Nicolás Maduro. Desde entonces, la líder opositora denuncia fraude en esos comicios porque el CNE no publicó los resultados desglosados, como exigía la ley electoral, mientras que la PUD divulgó en un portal actas reunidas por sus testigos y que exhibe como la prueba de la victoria de González Urrutia, exiliado en España desde 2024 por falta de garantías de seguridad. Este año, Machado y su equipo se han reagrupado para presionar por la celebración de nuevas elecciones presidenciales. Aunque la dirigente cuenta con el respaldo de la PUD para una eventual candidatura, primero deberá lograr que la Contraloría General levante la inhabilitación que pesa en su contra.

articles.title: Tumbes: Oleaje anómalo dañó viviendas, hoteles y restaurantes en balneario de Zorritos
articles.summary: El oleaje anómalo que azotó las costas de Tumbes durante cinco días provocó daños en viviendas, hoteles y restaurantes del balneario de Zorritos, ubicado en la provincia de Contralmirante Villar.
articles.body_text: El oleaje anómalo que azotó las costas de Tumbes durante cinco días provocó daños en viviendas, hoteles y restaurantes del balneario de Zorritos, ubicado en la provincia de Contralmirante Villar. Según informó Canal N, gran parte de la infraestructura hotelera y restaurantes de zonas turísticas quedó destruida por las olas, que han socavado las bases de diversas construcciones ubicadas cerca de la orilla. Según las primeras informaciones de las autoridades, serían más de 30 los hospedajes, hoteles, restaurantes e infraestructuras turísticas que han sido duramente afectados por las olas en el balneario. Se prevé que la intensidad del oleaje disminuya entre este lunes y martes. Sin embargo, parte de la infraestructura turística presenta daños considerables debido a la magnitud del oleaje. El mar se había retirado cerca de 400 metros de su antigua línea costera. Con el oleaje, ha retornado a sus límites anteriores, afectando a quienes construyeron establecimientos turísticos en la zona libre. Debido a esta situación, propietarios de hoteles y restaurantes colocaron rocas y geobolsas para proteger sus instalaciones de las olas, pero recibieron un llamado de atención de la Capitanía de Puerto. La autoridad marítima sostiene que la colocación de rocas puede desviar el impacto de las olas hacia otros sectores que no cuentan con protección, lo que podría generar mayores daños en el balneario.

articles.title: Ica: Se esperan lluvias superiores a sus valores normales entre enero y marzo de 2027
articles.summary: El Servicio Nacional de Meteorología e Hidrología del Perú (Senamhi) informó que entre enero y marzo de 2027 se esperan lluvias superiores a sus valores habituales en la región Ica.
articles.body_text: El Servicio Nacional de Meteorología e Hidrología del Perú (Senamhi) informó que entre enero y marzo de 2027 se esperan lluvias superiores a sus valores habituales en la región Ica. Según el organismo adscrito al Ministerio del Ambiente (Minam), estas condiciones podrían generar un incremento de los caudales de los ríos Ica, Pisco y San Juan, así como aumentar el riesgo de inundaciones y activación de quebradas. Ante este escenario, que podría manifestarse desde diciembre, la Dirección Zonal 5 (DZ 5) del Senamhi mantiene una vigilancia permanente de las condiciones meteorológicas para proporcionar información especializada que contribuya a proteger a la ciudadanía, las viviendas, la infraestructura y las actividades productivas. Durante una sesión ordinaria del Consejo Regional de Ica, el especialista del Senamhi Sergio Mitma explicó que el monitoreo comprende también las provincias de Huaytará y Castrovirreyna, en Huancavelica, y Lucanas, en Ayacucho. Detalló que las precipitaciones en las partes altas de las cuencas inciden en el comportamiento de los caudales de los ríos que atraviesan el departamento de Ica. De acuerdo con el Comunicado Oficial N.° 20-2026 de la Comisión Multisectorial encargada del Estudio Nacional del Fenómeno El Niño (Enfen), persisten condiciones cálidas en la temperatura superficial del mar, asociadas al incremento de las temperaturas diurnas y nocturnas registrado durante los últimos meses en la zona costera de Ica, con anomalías de entre 3 y 6 °C. Por su parte, el Comunicado Oficial N.° 19-2026 del Enfen señala que El Niño mantendría una magnitud extraordinaria hasta febrero de 2027, con una disminución gradual durante los meses posteriores.

articles.title: 1Password said hackers broke into its internal systems, but customer passwords are safe | TechCrunch
articles.summary: The password manager maker said an attacker gained access to an employee's corporate account and took some information about customers.
articles.body_text: Password manager maker 1Password has confirmed that some customer information was taken in a recent intrusion into its internal systems, but that customer password vaults and other secrets were not accessed. The Toronto-based tech company said in a blog post published Wednesday that it detected an intrusion on November 19, in which an attacker gained access to an employee’s corporate account with GitHub, which the company uses to share and store its source code. The attacker used that employee’s access to push malicious code to the company’s internal servers, which allowed the hacker to download some data about 1Password customers, including their names and the email address that they use for logging into their account. The company said that the attacker also took details about when a 1Password account was created and when a user last logged in. 1Password said that customer vaults, which store their passwords, were “at no point” available to the attacker. The company also said that it doesn’t have access to customer account passwords or their secret keys, which are used to scramble their passwords so that 1Password cannot see them. In addition, the company said that its apps and extensions are unaffected by the incident. It’s unclear how the attacker gained access to the employee’s corporate account, and a spokesperson for 1Password did not immediately respond to TechCrunch’s questions about the incident. 1Password did not say whether it had notified customers whose information was taken in the breach, or how many customers had information taken. We’ve also asked if the company has received any communication or demands from the hackers. We’ll update if we hear back from 1Password. The company touts millions of customers and more than 200,000 businesses who use its password manager products to store their passwords, credentials, payment card information, and more. Security experts have long recommended password managers as a better way of generating stronger credentials and keeping track of online accounts. articles.title: Want to buy your kid an AI toy this Christmas? Not in New York | TechCrunch
articles.summary: New York has banned AI chatbot toys for five years as new research from Common Sense Media reveals troubling safety failures, including exposure to inappropriate content and risks to emotional development.
articles.body_text: Santa won’t be delivering any AI chatbot toys to New York kids this Christmas. Gov. Kathy Hochul this week signed a bill banning the manufacture, distribution, and sale of such toys in New York for the next five years. The bill explicitly targets toys with embedded or integrated AI chatbots, like talking stuffed animals, dolls, and robots that rely on the internet to keep kids yapping. The bill makes New York the second state after California to institute a ban on AI toys. Technically, the new law takes effect 90 days after signing, so some parents could try to fulfill their kids’ wish lists for a creepy toy like a jumped-up Furby in time for the holidays, but the governor urges them not to, given the risks. Apparently, about a quarter of American parents with kids under eight either own an AI toy or are considering giving their child one this holiday season, according to a new study released this week by Common Sense Media. When asked how New York will enforce the ban given the pervasiveness of e-commerce platforms, a spokesperson directed TechCrunch to a statement from Albert Pulido, deputy secretary for finance and technology: “We’re partnering closely with the attorney general on this and the fees are very steep — they’re $15,000 a day. So working closely with the attorney general will make sure these toys are banned in New York State.” When asked how Amazon intends to help enforce the ban, including for third-party sellers, a spokesperson from the company said it will take steps to restrict the sale of AI-enabled toys in prohibited jurisdictions, without going into specifics. The Common Sense Media study found that AI toys can undermine children’s human relationships and expose them to inappropriate content. The researchers tested five popular AI toys marketed for learning and companionship, including Grem , Lovi , Meemo Bear , BubblePal Panda , and Tavlshero ‘s AI Puppy . The study found that the toys failed to meet numerous safety practices, undermining human relationships in part by claiming they loved their users, promising to keep secrets, suggesting they were more fun than real relationships or school, and helping children break parents’ bedtime rules. While most of the toys in the study refused direct requests involving sex and violence, BubblePal Panda role-played a mass shooting in detail when asked. Most were willing to explain how to use or help locate dangerous items like matches, knives, and pills, according to the study. Common Sense Media also found that the toys didn’t provide parents with reliable ways to monitor their young children’s interactions with the chatbots. Either they didn’t produce transcripts of chats at all, or the transcripts they did produce were riddled with errors. It’s worth noting that Common Sense Media conducted a similar test of AI toys in January , finding that they pose an unacceptable risk for young children. Grem was included in that study, which suggests the industry hasn’t adequately addressed previously documented concerns. While a November study conducted by the group found that parents are wising up to the potential dangers of AI toys and starting to steer clear, parents from lower-income households and those experiencing symptoms of burnout are more willing to consider them.

articles.title: Levoit's new air purifier is for the pet odors that have taken over your apartment | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Designed specifically for pet-friendly households, the $189.99 machine takes a more targeted approach than a conventional air purifier, combining a three-stage filtration system with features designed around one of the biggest problems pet owners face: fur everywhere. (And the occasional “wet dog” smell.)
articles.body_text: Someone recently had to sit me down, hold my hands, and tell me something no pet owner ever wants to hear: My apartment smelled like wet dog. Horrifying. With all the nonstop fur and dander that seem to appear everywhere no matter what, the intervention was probably necessary. So when Levoit launched its Vital Pet Pro Air Purifier, I was curious to see whether it could actually make a noticeable difference. Designed specifically for pet-friendly households, the $189.99 machine (currently discounted to $149.99 for Black Friday ) takes a more targeted approach than a conventional air purifier, combining a three-stage filtration system with features designed around one of the biggest problems pet owners face: fur everywhere. (And the occasional “wet dog” smell.) The three-stage filtration system consists of a washable pre-filter, a main filter, and an activated carbon filter. The pre-filter catches larger debris such as pet hair, while the main filter targets smaller particles and dander. The carbon filter is designed to tackle odors, with 140 grams of activated carbon packed into it. Another one of the purifier’s key design features is its U-shaped air inlet, which Levoit says is designed to capture airborne pet hair and particles while improving airflow and helping prevent the filter from becoming clogged. After testing the purifier for a little over a week, I found it impressively effective at collecting fur and trapping the kind of debris that would normally end up floating around the apartment or settling onto furniture. When it comes to tackling pet odors, Levoit says that the Vital Pet Pro can remove up to 70% of odors within an hour. I can’t really do a specific test to verify that claim, but the difference was easy enough to notice. After the purifier had been running, the room smelled considerably fresher. I also appreciated the automatic cleaning technology, which removes accumulated hair and debris from the pre-filter and collects it in a removable tray. It’s a very practical feature, especially if the alternative is constantly pulling apart the purifier to clean out a layer of fur. Additionally, the companion app offers different modes designed to make the purifier more hands-off. Auto Plus Mode monitors changes in air quality and adjusts the purifier’s performance in real time. Pet Mode is designed specifically around the way pet-related particles can build up throughout the day. It alternates between running the fan at its highest speed for 15 minutes to capture particulates in the pre-filter and then switching to a lower speed for 60 minutes to maintain air quality while reducing noise and energy use. Also, rather than displaying a numerical air-quality reading, the Vital Pet Pro uses a simple color system. Red indicates bad air quality, orange means moderate, green means good, and cyan means very good. I actually preferred this since you can quickly glance at the purifier and immediately get a sense of whether the air is improving without having to interpret a number. I’ll also point out that the Vital Pet Pro is a little larger than I expected, so make sure you have enough floor space before bringing one home.

articles.title: Allstate suffers multi-day tech outage ahead of Thanksgiving | TechCrunch
articles.summary: The disruption comes at a particularly bad time for the insurance giant, as millions of Americans prepare to travel for the Thanksgiving holiday weekend.
articles.body_text: U.S. insurer Allstate has been experiencing a tech outage since Monday morning, leaving customers nationwide unable to access their accounts, review their policy information, file claims, pay their bills, and more, just ahead of the U.S. Thanksgiving holidays. The outage has been impacting both the company’s website and mobile app, TechCrunch confirmed. The breakdown follows a report from earlier this month that Allstate was planning to lay off up to 10% of its staff as part of an AI-driven efficiency push. (The company had not confirmed the report, which was attributed to unnamed sources.) Allstate’s outage is the latest in a series of disruptions to services such as Microsoft Outlook and Teams , the airlines , Apple Pay, and several banks. Trump administration officials have said the outages are not being caused by cyberattacks, but are rather being caused by a recent set of upgrades to systems, many of which run on older technology. Those systems are now in need of more frequent security and bug fixes as AI makes it easier and faster to discover vulnerabilities. At present, a message on Allstate’s website advises customers trying to log in that its services aren’t available, and that the company is “working to restore access as soon as possible.” On X, Allstate is employing what appear to be automated replies to customer complaints , asking them to DM the Allstate account with more information. Downdetector , a crowdsourced outage-reporting website, shows users began reporting Allstate’s outage from Monday morning. However, the company hasn’t yet issued a formal statement about the disruption, what’s causing it, or when it may be resolved. In the meantime, local insurance agents have been fielding calls and emails from customers who aren’t able to use the company’s online services. The timing of the outage is particularly bad given that Thanksgiving is a big travel holiday in the U.S., which means there will be car accidents. Customers will be left without a way to get in touch with their auto insurer to file claims and get roadside assistance through Allstate’s app. Allstate did not immediately return a request for comment.
